description: CFD 2D oscillatory flow (U-tube type): periodic channel 8 x 13 cells with a slip lid (C 16 3), single phase, k-omega, oscillating body force B 180/181 (U = 0.3 sin(pi t) m/s, T 2 s), MPM sand bed (d50 1 mm, S 35 50). Bed shear S 16 9: max(log law at 1.6 DZN, wave friction 0.5 rho fw |u_w|^2 with Soulsby fw, A from the running mean and orbital amplitude of the sample), wave period from S 58.
covers: bedshear_cfd S 16 9 (tau_wave, tau_wave_step, running mean, du/dt amplitude)
